featured.name: Hornbill Habitat Suitability Modelling
featured.context: With SACON & Coimbatore Institute of Technology
featured.summary: An autoencoder-based pipeline that combines satellite imagery, climate records and GPS telemetry to map where two threatened hornbill species can thrive in Northeast India.
featured.problem: Conservation teams need to know which areas can support Great and Wreathed Hornbills, but the evidence is scattered across GPS telemetry, sightings, satellite imagery and climate records in different formats and resolutions.
implementation: Cleaned and normalised telemetry and environmental features, then trained an autoencoder that compresses each location's conditions into a compact habitat signature.
Scored locations by similarity to known hornbill habitat, clustered the results into habitat zones, and used SHAP to explain which variables matter most.
Rendered suitability and movement maps with GeoPandas, Folium and Plotly for the ecologists.
findings: Humidity, dew point and temperature were the strongest drivers of suitability.
Priority conservation regions were mapped across Northeast India and the work was written up as a conference paper.

projects.name: Socio API
projects.summary: A REST API for a social-media backend: accounts, posts and comments with authenticated create, update and delete.
decisions: FastAPI with typed request/response schemas, so OpenAPI docs are generated at /docs
SQLAlchemy ORM on PostgreSQL, with every schema change versioned as an Alembic migration
Auth-protected write endpoints, covered by a pytest suite

projects.name: Fun-Gram
projects.summary: An Instagram-style social app with sign-up, image posts, likes, comments and editable profiles.
decisions: Firebase Auth, Firestore and Storage instead of a custom server, keeping the app serverless
Firestore real-time listeners so likes and comments update live without polling
Responsive React UI built with Chakra UI and deployed on Firebase Hosting

projects.name: Easy-Kart
projects.summary: A Django storefront with product search and filtering, a cart, and checkout through Stripe.
decisions: Payments delegated to Stripe rather than handled by the app
Django auth for registration and login; Django admin for products, categories and orders
Server-rendered templates with Tailwind CSS on SQLite
